title: August and the Drop
author: C. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Okafor, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
